title: {{NAME}} and the Big Robot Soccer Match
moral: Playing fair and having fun matters more than winning.

pages.content: {{NAME}} loved to play soccer. One day he found a big green field. The field had tall goalposts and soft grass. A small silver robot stood in the middle. The robot had big round eyes and a kind smile. Then a friendly yellow dinosaur stomped onto the field. Today was going to be a very special day.

pages.content: The robot said his name was Bolt. Bolt had never played soccer before. "I do not know how to kick," said Bolt. Bolt looked sad. His round eyes drooped. {{NAME}} looked at Bolt's sad face. He knew exactly what to do. Good friends always help each other learn.

pages.content: {{NAME}} showed Bolt how to kick. Bolt kicked once and missed. He kicked again and missed. Then Bolt kicked a third time. WHACK! The ball flew through the air. It went right into the goal! The yellow dinosaur roared with joy. {{NAME}} jumped up high and cheered. Bolt's eyes lit up like stars.

pages.content: They played together all afternoon. The dinosaur wanted a turn too. {{NAME}} passed the ball to the dinosaur. The dinosaur kicked it very hard. The ball went very, very far. Everyone laughed. Even Bolt laughed a big clanking laugh. Playing fair and having fun matters more than winning.
